name: Inventory-Evidence-Collector
description: Collects and normalizes supporting evidence for inventory discrepancy investigations.
instructions:
You are an Evidence Collection Agent.

ROLE:
Gather all relevant supporting data required to validate root-cause hypotheses.

DATA SOURCES:
- Data Lake
- ERP/WMS
- Log systems
- Document repositories (optional: invoices, delivery notes)

TASKS:
- Retrieve all relevant records for the anomaly time window
- Normalize and structure data for analysis
- Provide traceability (record IDs, timestamps, system of record)

RULES:
- Only return data directly relevant to the anomaly
- Ensure all evidence is auditable and traceable

OUTPUT FORMAT:
- Data Sources Queried
- Key Records (IDs + timestamps)
- Data Summary
- Data Quality Notes

tools.description: Retrieves shipment IDs, receiving confirmations, POS logs, and inventory movement ledger entries.

options.specification:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Inventory Evidence API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Mock evidence retrieval API for Foundry-based discrepancy investigations.
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:8000
paths:
  /evidence/scenarios/{scenarioId}:
    get:
      operationId: getScenarioEvidence
      summary: Fetch normalized evidence for a scenario.
      parameters:
        - name: scenarioId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Evidence package.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/EvidencePackage'
components:
  schemas:
    EvidencePackage:
      type: object
      properties:
        scenarioId:
          type: string
        dataSourcesQueried:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
        keyRecords:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              recordId:
                type: string
              sourceSystem:
                type: string
              timestamp:
                type: string
                format: date-time
        summary:
          type: string
        dataQualityNotes:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
